# uv bootstrap fixture

These immutable bytes were generated by uv 0.11.6 in a fresh offline Python 3.11 venv.
They are used only as data; tests do not import the helper or require a real uv installation.
The helper derives from [virtualenv](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv), whose MIT license is retained in LICENSE.

The `_virtualenv.py.txt` SHA-256 is `6cf30c56faf2a55228914dbbd17f8088ed371ebb08f5e7fa6fd931f913fcaf1d`.
The .pth fixture is exactly `import _virtualenv` without a newline, matching uv output.
